description: This file defines the Upload class in the Opencart admin model, which manages file upload records in the database. It includes methods to add, delete, retrieve, and list uploads with filtering options.

classes.name: Upload
classes.description: A model class for managing upload records in the database within the Opencart admin area.

methods.name: addUpload
methods.description: Creates a new upload record with a generated token and stores it in the database.

methods.name: deleteUpload
methods.description: Deletes an upload record by its primary key.

methods.name: getUpload
methods.description: Retrieves a specific upload record by its ID.

methods.name: getUploadByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a specific upload record by its unique code.

methods.name: getUploads
methods.description: Retrieves a list of upload records based on provided filters, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalUploads
methods.description: Returns the total count of upload records matching the filters.

methods.name: addUpload
methods.description: Creates a new upload entry in the database with a unique token, name, and filename.

methods.name: deleteUpload
methods.description: Deletes an upload record from the database based on its ID.

methods.name: getUpload
methods.description: Fetches detailed information about an upload by its ID.

methods.name: getUploadByCode
methods.description: Fetches upload data associated with a specific code.

methods.name: getUploads
methods.description: Retrieves multiple upload records based on filters such as name, date, and code, with sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalUploads
methods.description: Calculates the total number of upload records matching certain filters.
